# Velair 1.6.0

Velair 1.6.0 brings the work tested throughout the 1.6 beta series into a
stable release. It expands native climate capabilities, makes Room Assist and
command delivery safer, restores weekly schedule continuity, and adds optional
Home Assistant blueprints for common automations.

## ✨ Added

- Added native lower and upper temperature targets for compatible `heat_cool`
  climates across schedules, Profiles, templates, services, Boost, Adaptive
  Preconditioning, Room Assist, the timeline, and Overview. Profile schedules
  activated directly or through Modes retain the complete range.
- Profile schedules can now save the current day as a reusable template or
  clone it to other compatible managed climates.
- Added optional Home Assistant blueprints that run chosen actions when one
  consolidated occupancy entity changes between Home and Away, or pause one
  or more managed climates while selected windows or doors remain open. They
  are event-driven, require no polling, and report sustained unavailable
  inputs through delayed notifications that dismiss automatically after
  recovery. Each starts at blueprint version 1.0.0 with visible Home Assistant
  and Velair compatibility, an individual changelog, and a stable rolling
  import URL protected by versioned input contracts.
- Added a responsive public [Velair website](https://cgonfer.github.io/velair/)
  with product guidance, light and dark screenshots, feature navigation,
  installation access, and community links.
- Added Russian integration strings and reviewed Russian coverage for most of
  the Velair interface, based on
  [#10](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/pull/10) by
  [@chigelo](https://github.com/chigelo). Newer strings that still need
  linguistic review fall back safely to English.

## 🔄 Changed

- **Schedules** is now the canonical workspace for both Default and Profile
  schedules, using the same weekly editing structure in each context. Profile
  edits remain atomic and show pending changes and per-thermostat behavior
  summaries, while direct Profile activation remains available. **Modes** is
  focused on composing reusable setups and managing the active setup.
- Schedules opens on the current local weekday, preserves the selected day
  while users work, and protects unsaved drafts before changing schedule
  source or leaving the editor. The panel now places Schedules before Modes to
  match the define-then-compose workflow.
- Room Assist now applies signed corrections in both directions, prevents a
  drifting internal sensor from moving a protected target past the scheduled
  target, and moves native `heat_cool` ranges as complete width-preserving
  bands.
- Zone pauses can now retain multiple independent reasons. Automation helpers
  can remove only the reason identified by their `pause_id`; `resume_all: true`
  and legacy resume calls without an ID retain explicit full-resume authority.
- Starting a Boost is rejected while a zone still has an active pause reason.
  Pausing during a Boost ends that Boost before pause control takes authority.
- Adaptive Preconditioning can start a complete `heat_cool` range early using
  the relevant heating or cooling boundary while preserving learning history.
- Portable import and export now use model version 6 so native temperature
  ranges remain intact between installations.

## 🚀 Improved

- Scheduler-owned climate targets now use bounded retries after explicit Home
  Assistant service failures and re-resolve current intent when a managed
  climate becomes available again, without polling or replaying stale targets.
- Room Assist now exposes its scheduled target, external sensor, internal
  climate reading, applied target, signed correction, scheduled protection,
  physical limits, and current state. Overview summarizes active control as
  Active, Holding, or Scheduled protection, and physical-limit problems create
  one recoverable Home Assistant notification.
- Profile editing actions, native range inputs, inherited timeline periods,
  live graphs, contextual help, compact mobile block editors, and public
  screenshots have been refined for desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts.
- Fast panel loads no longer flash internal scheduler wording. Slower initial
  loads show a small local Velair icon and a static loading label.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed the final weekly block not remaining active across midnight or empty
  weekdays, including startup and Profile or Mode activation. Its inherited
  period is now shown distinctly in the timeline with its target and HVAC mode.
- Fixed single-temperature Profile schedules being rejected when an
  integration hides its temperature-target capability while the climate is
  off. Velair now enters a compatible HVAC mode before applying the target,
  while native ranges remain strictly validated.
- Fixed delayed or superseded climate operations changing Room Assist or
  Adaptive Preconditioning runtime state after their intent was no longer
  current.
- Fixed Room Assist continuing to drive heating or cooling after the external
  room sensor crossed its scheduled target, and prevented internal-sensor drift
  from walking a protected target in the wrong direction.
- Fixed overlapping Room Assist scale labels and kept decimal climate targets
  with their applied offsets fully visible without making the callout taller.
- Fixed Profile validation messages identifying the wrong weekday or
  start-time requirement, native mobile time fields obscuring AM/PM, and
  contextual help extending beyond the screen on smaller devices.
- Fixed clone-result messages relying on an English plural suffix. They now use
  locale-neutral count labels that remain grammatical in Russian and existing
  translations.

## 🧭 Notes

- Existing schedules, Profiles, Boosts, and active single-reason pauses remain
  compatible. Stored pauses are upgraded additively when Velair next saves its
  data; no manual migration is required.
- The sidebar Schedules workspace can edit both Default and Profile schedules.
  The optional Lovelace `view: schedules` remains Default-only so existing
  dashboard cards keep their established behavior.
- Blueprints are optional and must be imported separately from the
  [Automation Blueprints guide](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/blob/v1.6.0/docs/user/blueprints.md).
- Room Assist controls Home Assistant targets but cannot override device
  firmware hysteresis, compressor protection, or minimum run times. Use an
  `Off` block when an explicit shutdown is required.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser
  or companion app so the stable backend and frontend bundle are both loaded.
